def test_hex_key():
    # empty and non-prime cases
    assert hex_key("") == 0
    assert hex_key("0000") == 0
    assert hex_key("0000FFFF") == 0
    assert hex_key("148AEF") == 0

    # single prime digits: 2,3,5,7,B=11,D=13
    assert hex_key("2") == 1
    assert hex_key("B") == 1
    assert hex_key("D") == 1

    # mixed cases
    assert hex_key("AB") == 1 # A=10 no, B=11 yes
    assert hex_key("1077E") == 2
    assert hex_key("ABED1A33") == 4
    assert hex_key("123456789ABCDEF") == 6

    # all prime digits
    assert hex_key("2357BD") == 6
    assert hex_key("2222") == 4
